Scalar API Reference 1.63.0
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@scalar/api-reference
Vendored dist: dist/browser/standalone.js -> standalone.js (self-contained IIFE, no chunks).
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Exposes `window.Scalar.createApiReference(selectorOrElement, { url })`, which renders
an interactive API explorer for an OpenAPI document with a live "Try it out" panel.
Atlas serves this asset only for the docs UI (`atlas serve --docs`); see ADR-0043.
